plain: Ended a meeting for a time, to meet again later

webster.text: Put off, delayed, or deferred for a limited time.

more.text: As an adjective, existing or held by adjournment, as an adjourned session of a court, opposed to stated or regular.

example.quote: He said they hoped to have such an one ready by tomorrow to be laid before the Convention: And the Convention adjourned that leisure might be given for the purpose.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, June 14, 1787
